# participation instrument item

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationInstrumentItem`](gmeow-participationInstrumentItem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationInstrumentItem>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The specific instrument item used in this participation — the particular 1959 Les Paul (a [`PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)), a synth plugin (an [`InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md)), the named drum kit, etc. Ranges over [`Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) so that any item-kind can be named without minting a new class (instruments and configurations; [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Functional per relator.
